user.title: Notify once
user.description: Get notified exactly once when an entity reaches a state or threshold. There is nothing to configure. Confirm to set it up.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Notify once is already set up.

watch.name: Watch
watch.description: Starts a watch that sends exactly one notification when the condition becomes true, then ends.

state.name: State
state.description: The state to wait for. Used with the condition 'State equals'. Quote values like "on" in YAML.

threshold.name: Threshold
threshold.description: The number to cross. Used with 'Value rises above' and 'Value falls below'.

notifier.name: Notify via
notifier.description: A notify service or notify entity, for example notify.mobile_app_my_phone. Defaults to a persistent notification.

message.name: Message
message.description: Custom text. Leave empty for an automatic text.

hours.name: Maximum wait
hours.description: The watch ends without a notification after this many hours.

language.name: Language
language.description: Language of the automatic text (de or en). Defaults to the Home Assistant language.

cancel.name: Cancel watch
cancel.description: Cancels one watch without a notification.

id.name: ID
id.description: The ID of the watch, shown in the attributes of the active watches sensor.

cancel_all.name: Cancel all watches
cancel_all.description: Cancels every active watch without a notification.

too_many_watches.message: There are already {max} active watches. Cancel one first.

watch_not_found.message: There is no active watch with the ID {id}.

not_loaded.message: Notify once is not set up. Add it under Settings, Devices & services.
